{{Quote|So much of the traveling is now undertaken by refugees leaving the Republic or seceded worlds, people who have abandoned homes, families and careers. Do we need to burden them even further?|Bail Organa|<ref name="HNN47" />}}
The '''transit tax''' was a controversial bill proposed by the [[Coruscant Ministry of Ingress/Legends|Coruscant Ministry of Ingress]]<ref name="FF86" /> and approved by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. It forced all travelers going to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to pay a fifteen per cent levy on top of the price of their ticket.<ref name="HNN47" />

The transit tax made it difficult for [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] to go to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was also seen as a way of making a profit from the poorest folk in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was vocally critical of the transit tax.<ref name="HNN47" />

Soon after the passage of the transit tax, the Coruscant Ministry of Ingress instituted severe restrictions on immigration. These new measures included the necessity to carry a confusing range of documents. Many of these were simply unobtainable by normal citizens, effectively making legal entry onto Coruscant impossible.<ref name="HNN51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_1.html|Coruscant Restricts Immigration}}</ref>
